info.title: Mark Sign
info.description: Mark Sign is a qualified electronic signature service compliant with eIDAS regulation. Send documents for signing, wait for the signatures, download and validate the signed files.

post.description: Uploads a document and prepares it for signing.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The name of the file with its extension, for example contract.pdf. It becomes the document title.

schema.description: The content of the file to send for signing (PDF, ADoc, BDoc or ASiC-E).

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Who can view the document. Default is private.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Invites a person to sign the document. Mark Sign sends the invitation by email.

language.description: The language of the invitation. Default is Lithuanian.

success_url.description: Where to send the signer after they finish signing.

callback_url.description: A URL to notify when the document is signed.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Lists the signers of a document with their signing status.

status.description: Whether the signer has signed: pending, signed, rejected, reviewing, confirmed, denied or reviewed.

rejection_reason.description: The reason the signer gave when rejecting the document.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

x-ms-notification-content.description: The signature event that resumed the flow.

post.description: Waits until the next signer signs or rejects the document, without sending any invitations. Use it in a loop to wait for several signers without polling.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Waits until every signer has signed or someone rejected the document, then lets the flow continue. Ends with the timed_out status when the time runs out.

parameters.name: timeout_minutes
parameters.description: How long to wait, in minutes, before ending with the timed_out status. Default is 41760 (29 days), maximum is 43200 (30 days).

200.description: The document was signed or rejected, or the wait timed out.

202.description: The signing is still in progress. Power Automate follows the Location header and polls again.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Gets the signing status of a document.

document_status.description: The signing status: saved (waiting for signatures), signed_partially (some have signed) or signed (everyone has signed).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Downloads the document with all signatures collected so far.

schema.description: The content of the document file.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Lists the documents in your workspace, newest first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A phrase to look for in document titles and file names.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many documents to return. Default is 10.

status.description: The signing status of the document, such as saved (waiting for signatures), signed_partially or signed.

total.description: The total number of matching documents.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

delete.description: Removes a document from your workspace.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Combines several files into one signable container document, such as an ADoc or ASiC-E. The files are uploaded and combined in a single step.

document_type.description: The type of document to create.

files.description: The files to combine into the container.

file_name.description: The name of the file with its extension, for example contract.pdf.

adoc_file_type.description: The role of the file in the container. Only used when the document type is an ADoc.

filename.description: The name of the document file.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates a personal signing link for each signer. You deliver the links yourself, for example by email or Teams message.

documents.description: The documents to create signing links for. Use Document ID values from upload or list steps.

signers.description: The people to create links for. Give each one an email or a signer ID. At least one of the two is required.

id.description: Your own ID for the signer, unique within the request. Required when Email is empty.

email.description: The signer's email address. Required when Signer ID is empty.

personal_code.description: The signer's personal code. Needed when authentication is required.

authentication_required.description: If yes, the signer must verify their identity before opening the link.

position.description: The signer's job position, shown in ADoc signatures.

structural_subdivision.description: The signer's department, shown in ADoc signatures.

signing_purpose.description: Why the person signs, shown in ADoc signatures.

callback_url.description: A URL to notify when the document is signed.

reject_callback_url.description: A URL to notify when a signer rejects the document.

expire_after.description: Minutes until the link expires. Default is 2880 (two days).

show_reject_button.description: Whether signers can reject the document on the signing page. Default is yes.

delete_document_after.description: Minutes until the document is deleted from the workspace. By default it is kept.

id.description: Your own ID for the signer.

temporary_signing_link.description: The link the signer opens to sign the document.

temporary_signing_link_id.description: The ID of the signing link.

valid_until.description: When the link expires, as a Unix timestamp.

documents.description: The documents the links were created for.

filename.description: The name of the document file.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

delete.description: Deletes a signer link or shared link before it expires. Invitation links cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: temporarySigningLinkId
parameters.description: The Signing Link ID from the output of "Signing: Create signer links" or "Signing: Create shared link".

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Upgrades the document signatures for long-term validity or archiving.

parameters.name: body

level.description: LT for long-term validity, LTA for long-term archiving.

parameters.description: The signature level to extend to.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Checks the signatures of a document and returns the validation report. The flow waits until the check finishes.

document.description: The overall result for the document.

is_valid.description: Whether the document signatures are valid.

valid_to.description: How long the document stays valid.

mimetype.description: The file type of the document.

valid_to.description: How long the signature stays valid.

certificates.description: The certificates used by the signatures.

timestamps.description: The timestamps applied to the document.

202.description: The validation is still running. Power Automate follows the Location header and polls again.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

get.description: Waits until one particular signer signs the document, then lets the flow continue. Ends with the timed_out status when the time runs out.

parameters.name: signer_email
parameters.description: The email of the signer to wait for, the same email used when inviting them.

parameters.name: timeout_minutes
parameters.description: How long to wait, in minutes, before ending with the timed_out status. Default is 41760 (29 days), maximum is 43200 (30 days).

200.description: The signer signed, someone rejected the document, or the wait timed out.

202.description: The signing is still in progress. Power Automate follows the Location header and polls again.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates one signing link that anyone can open to sign the documents. You deliver it yourself.

documents.description: The documents the link signs. Use Document ID values from upload or list steps.

callback_url.description: A URL to notify when the document is signed.

expire_after.description: Minutes until the link expires. Default is 2880 (two days).

delete_document_after.description: Minutes until the document is deleted from the workspace. By default it is kept.

signing_link.description: The link anyone can open to sign.

signing_link_id.description: The ID of the link, for "Signing: Delete link".

valid_until.description: When the link expires, as a Unix timestamp.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

post.description: Adds a signer to the document without sending an email, and returns their personal invitation link for you to deliver. The link does not expire and cannot be deleted; use "Signing: Create signer links" when you need links you can revoke.

success_url.description: Where to send the signer after they finish signing.

callback_url.description: A URL to notify when the document is signed.

invitation_url.description: The personal signing page link to deliver to the signer.

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

status.description: The signing status of the document, such as signed or signed_partially. A rejection shows in the signer statuses.

members_count.description: How many people were invited to sign.

status.description: The signer status, such as pending, signed or rejected.

document_status.description: How the waiting ended: signed, rejected or timed_out.

rejected_by.description: Who rejected the document, if it was rejected.

rejection_reason.description: The reason the signer gave, if the document was rejected.

SignerPurpose.description: Why the person is invited. Choose review to invite for viewing only.

DocumentId.name: documentId
DocumentId.description: The ID of the document, from the output of "Document: Upload", "Document: Upload as container" or "Document: List".
